verses.text: We sat by the rivers of Babylon and cried when Zion came to mind.
We hung our harps on the willows there.
The people who took us captive asked for songs. The ones who tormented us wanted us to sound happy: “Sing us one of Zion’s songs!”
How are we supposed to sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?
Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand forget how to play.
Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I forget you, if I don’t hold Jerusalem above my greatest joy.
LORD, remember what Edom’s people did the day Jerusalem fell. They shouted, “Tear it down! Tear it down to the foundations!”
Daughter of Babylon, you’re headed for ruin. Happy is the one who pays you back for what you did to us.
Happy is the one who takes your little ones and dashes them against the rock.
